keywords: ERC-8339 接收方签名同意的转账
EIP-8272 与 EIP-8141 签名计费
summary: ERC-8339 改为接收方签名同意的转账，构建在 EIP-8141 frame 交易之上，不再需要托管和第二笔交易。EIP-8272 提交两处修正，其中一处恢复 EIP-8141 的签名验证费用和签名 calldata 费用，避免 frame 交易签名少收费。Starknet 隐私 SDK 和 Wallet API 上线。Jesse Pollak 发长文谈 Base 的反思，据 Ethereal news #31，Base 将聚焦全球金融。

items.title: ERC-8339：接收方签名同意的转账
items.note: （muhammadaus）提交，原名两阶段资产转账，这一版移除了托管、撤销/取回和密钥流程。论坛说明 14:00：只有接收方为这笔转账签了同意才执行，无需托管、无需第二笔交易、也没有挂起状态，基于 EIP-8141 frame 交易，适用于 ETH 与 ERC-20/721/1155。
items.note_en: (muhammadaus), submitted; previously titled Two-Phase Asset Transfers, this revision removes the escrow, revoke/reclaim and secret-key flow. Forum write-up, 14:00: a transfer runs only if the receiver has signed consent for exactly that transfer, with no escrow, no second transaction and no pending state; it builds on EIP-8141 frame transactions and covers ETH and ERC-20/721/1155.

items.title: EIP-8272：在 tx_gas_limit 中恢复 EIP-8141 签名费用
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）提交。8272 作为 8141 的增量，重述 `tx_gas_limit` 时漏掉了 `signature_verification_cost` 和签名的 calldata 费用，导致分叉后 frame 交易签名被少收费。同一作者还提交 修正 TXPARAM_RECENT_ROOT_REFERENCE_COUNT 取值不一致，常量表写 `0x0F`，TXPARAM 表写 `0x0D`。
items.title_en: EIP-8272: restore EIP-8141 signature costs in tx_gas_limit
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil), submitted. As a delta on 8141, 8272 restated `tx_gas_limit` but dropped `signature_verification_cost` and the signatures' calldata cost, so post-fork frame transactions were under-charged for signatures. The same author also submitted a fix for the TXPARAM_RECENT_ROOT_REFERENCE_COUNT value inconsistency: the constants table says `0x0F` while the TXPARAM table says `0x0D`.

summary_en: ERC-8339 was reworked into receiver-attested transfers built on EIP-8141 frame transactions, with no escrow and no second transaction. Two EIP-8272 fixes were submitted; one restores EIP-8141's signature verification cost and signature calldata cost so frame transaction signatures are not under-charged. Starknet's privacy SDK and Wallet API went live. Jesse Pollak posted a long reflection on Base; per Ethereal news #31, Base will focus on global finance.
